const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RGB-D and proprioception controller for the live DrainVeggies episode.
+
+Only the RCB client is used for observations and control.  This file is the
+episode record and the reusable Cartesian-motion helper used during it.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+EYE = "robot0_eye_in_hand"
+SCENE = "robot0_agentview_left"
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output/episode")
+
+
+def rotvec(R: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Log map of a 3x3 rotation matrix."""
+    angle = np.arccos(np.clip((np.trace(R) - 1.0) * 0.5, -1.0, 1.0))
+    skew = np.array([R[2, 1] - R[1, 2], R[0, 2] - R[2, 0], R[1, 0] - R[0, 1]])
+    if angle < 1e-7:
+        return 0.5 * skew
+    return angle / (2.0 * np.sin(angle)) * skew
+
+
+def pose_from_meta(meta):
+    p = np.asarray(meta["proprio"]["now"][26:29], dtype=float)
+    R = np.asarray(meta["cameras"][EYE]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)[:3, :3]
+    q = np.asarray(meta["proprio"]["now"][4:11], dtype=float)
+    return q, p, R
+
+
+class Controller:
+    def __init__(self, robot=None):
+        self.r = robot or Robot()
+        self.spec = self.r.spec()
+        self.joint_limits = np.array([
+            [-2.8973, 2.8973], [-1.7628, 1.7628], [-2.8973, 2.8973],
+            [-3.0718, -0.0698], [-2.8973, 2.8973], [-0.0175, 3.7525],
+            [-2.8973, 2.8973],
+        ])
+        self.grip = -1.0
+        self.camlist = [EYE, SCENE]
+        OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        self._snapshot("connect")
+
+    def _obs(self):
+        return self.r.get_obs(cameras=self.camlist, video="none")
+
+    def _snapshot(self, name, result=None):
+        if result is None:
+            result = self._obs()
+        d = OUT / name
+        result.save(str(d))
+        print("snapshot", name, "steps", result.meta.get("control_steps"),
+              "time_left", round(result.meta.get("time_left_s", -1), 1), flush=True)
+        return result
+
+    def state(self):
+        return pose_from_meta(self._obs().meta)
+
+    def command(self, q, grip=None, steps=12, note=""):
+        q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+        g = self.grip if grip is None else float(grip)
+        action = np.zeros(13, dtype=float)
+        action[:7] = q
+        action[7] = g
+        action[8:12] = 0.0
+        action[12] = -1.0
+        result = self.r.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(action[None, :], steps, axis=0),
+                               interpolate="hold", cameras=self.camlist, video="none", note=note)
+        self.grip = g
+        return result
+
+    def calibrate_jacobian(self, q, p, R, grip=None, eps=0.015, steps=10):
+        """Estimate the world-frame 6D tool Jacobian with small safe joint probes."""
+        J = np.zeros((6, 7), dtype=float)
+        q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float).copy()
+        grip = self.grip if grip is None else grip
+        for j in range(7):
+            qp = q.copy()
+            qp[j] += eps
+            if qp[j] > self.joint_limits[j, 1]:
+                qp[j] = q[j] - eps
+            delta_q = qp[j] - q[j]
+            probe = self.command(qp, grip=grip, steps=steps, note=f"jacobian probe joint {j+1}")
+            q_actual, p_probe, R_probe = pose_from_meta(probe.meta)
+            self.command(q, grip=grip, steps=steps, note=f"restore joint {j+1} probe")
+            dq_actual = q_actual[j] - q[j]
+            if abs(dq_actual) < 1e-5:
+                dq_actual = delta_q
+            J[:3, j] = (p_probe - p) / dq_actual
+            J[3:, j] = rotvec(R_probe @ R.T) / dq_actual
+        return J
+
+    def _solve(self, J, error, damping=0.035):
+        # Damped least squares, with the orientation coordinates in radians.
+        JT = J.T
+        return JT @ np.linalg.solve(J @ JT + np.eye(6) * damping * damping, error)
+
+    def move_pose(self, target_p, target_R=None, max_iter=18, max_joint_step=0.10,
+                  pos_tol=0.012, rot_tol=0.12, label="move"):
+        target_p = np.asarray(target_p, dtype=float)
+        q, p, R = self.state()
+        target_R = R.copy() if target_R is None else np.asarray(target_R, dtype=float)
+        print(label, "from", np.round(p, 3), "to", np.round(target_p, 3), flush=True)
+        for it in range(max_iter):
+            q, p, R = self.state()
+            ep = target_p - p
+            er = rotvec(target_R @ R.T)
+            print(label, "iter", it, "p", np.round(p, 3), "err", np.round(ep, 3),
+                  "rot", round(float(np.linalg.norm(er)), 3), flush=True)
+            if np.linalg.norm(ep) < pos_tol and np.linalg.norm(er) < rot_tol:
+                self._snapshot(label.replace(" ", "_") + "_done")
+                return q, p, R
+            J = self.calibrate_jacobian(q, p, R)
+            # Limit the Cartesian correction per iteration so the arm traces a
+            # short, observable path and the local Jacobian remains useful.
+            e = np.r_[ep, er]
+            epn, ern = np.linalg.norm(ep), np.linalg.norm(er)
+            if epn > 0.045:
+                e[:3] *= 0.045 / epn
+            if ern > 0.16:
+                e[3:] *= 0.16 / ern
+            dq = self._solve(J, e)
+            scale = min(1.0, max_joint_step / max(1e-9, np.max(np.abs(dq))))
+            qcmd = np.clip(q + scale * dq, self.joint_limits[:, 0], self.joint_limits[:, 1])
+            result = self.command(qcmd, note=f"{label} cartesian step {it}")
+            if it % 3 == 2:
+                self._snapshot(f"{label.replace(' ', '_')}_{it}", result)
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{label} did not converge; latest proprio state retained")
+
+    def move_position(self, target_p, target_R=None, **kwargs):
+        return self.move_pose(target_p, target_R, **kwargs)
+
+    def set_gripper(self, grip, steps=12, note="gripper"):
+        q, _, _ = self.state()
+        result = self.command(q, grip=grip, steps=steps, note=note)
+        self._snapshot(note.replace(" ", "_") + ("_closed" if grip > 0 else "_open"), result)
+
+
+def main():
+    c = Controller()
+    q, p, R = c.state()
+    print("initial", np.round(p, 4), "q", np.round(q, 4), flush=True)
+    # The initial RGB-D estimate from the calibrated left camera places the
+    # lettuce in its metal pot near (6.54, -1.84, 1.08) m.  First move to a
+    # hover point above it; subsequent stages are added after visual checks.
+    c.move_pose([6.54, -1.84, 1.30], R, label="hover_over_pot")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
